title: For your consideration
author: LevelFisherman9076
selftext:
Would you consider looking at 21st Century Hack?

The team at George Stone Games has modernized the original Hack 1.0.3 and it’s pretty amazing. That last version of Hack before NetHack is like D&D to AD&D, there’s something fun and fast moving about it. Generative AI was used for the artwork nothing else.
